title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a second input to the Session 1 lookup table
body:
## Problem
Session 1 has one input; the cost of connect-the-dots with two inputs is only mentioned in words.

## Context
The point of Session 1 is that tables need n x n runs for two inputs.

## Expected outcome
A small function that builds a two-input table for dy/dt = -k y with a second input (the start value y0) and prints the number of runs and the error.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A check that a grid of 18 by 18 values uses 324 runs
- [ ] `python start.py check 1` still prints PASS

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: an ensemble that flags extrapolation
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. The Session 3 audit shows the network answers confidently outside its range.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and asserted
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Report the worst case, not only the mean, in the Session 3 audit
body:
## Problem
The audit reports mean rollout errors; the worst held-out run matters more for deciding whether a surrogate can be used.

## Context
The worst y1 error over the held-out runs is 0.056, several times the mean.

## Expected outcome
Extra output and a figure that show the distribution of rollout errors over the held-out runs, and which initial conditions are worst.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A histogram or box plot figure saved to the output folder
- [ ] A checkpoint line that asserts the worst-case value

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an audited ensemble surrogate
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows ensembles of surrogates with an error band, a conservation panel and a speed bar; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Worst-case y1 error below 0.02 on held-out runs
- [ ] Short write-up of your method and timing

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
